svg.title: The Wire
svg.desc: Trace Bloom section banner for The Wire on lifehacker.dev. The model beat, reported straight: releases, benchmarks, incidents, and the theater around them. Every dispatch pins its sources; reality was reached for comment. A manhattan lattice probed by 2 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Fallback cover for wire dispatches that carry no banner of their own. Seed 3066272214.
